name: Cyba
source:
Once the radiance of divine benevolence, Cyba was the world's guiding light. But sadly, three hundred years ago, a cataclysmic betrayal shattered her essence and stripped her of nearly all her power. For centuries, she has sought a champion worthy enough to reunite the Scattered Divine fragments and restore her to full glory.

[From [URL=https://www.patreon.com/posts/official-for-148958937]Patreon[/URL]]
